extraction.notes: Three months ended Dec 31, 2023 column. Starting line is GAAP net loss attributable to common stockholders (-1,737) from the FFO note on page 10; the FFO and AFFO sections are both in page 10 (seq 12). Company reports no core FFO. AFFO starts from NAREIT FFO (6,278) and the AFFO line 'Less: insurance recovery of casualty loss' is printed as (323) in the reconciliation, while the income statement shows insurance recovery of casualty loss of 317 for the quarter; I used the reconciliation figure (323), which ties to the printed AFFO of 7,117. Zero-amount lines (no current-quarter activity shown as '—') are included for completeness. Diluted share count 18,560,985 (printed in full) divided by 1,000 = 18,560.985 thousand; check: 6,278/18,560.985 = 0.34 and 7,117/18,560.985 = 0.38. Recurring capex of $1.4 million is from the highlights on page 3 (seq 19) and is for the Combined Portfolio, which is broader than the company's own share; the highlights describe it as rounded to $1.4 million, so the value 1,400 (thousands) is approximate. Additional $578,000 of replacement costs in real estate operating expenses was not added to recurring capex.
